functional_semantics.triton: out[2i]=A[i], out[2i+1]=B[i] via tl.interleave of equal input blocks (impl_triton.py:18-25); dtype preserved, int8 served by the same kernel.
functional_semantics.cutile: same placement via reshape/cat/flatten of the two input tiles (impl_cutile.py:24-27); dtype preserved.
functional_semantics.note: Both match impl_torch.py:5-7 (empty(2N) + two stride-2 slice assignments). Generator tensors.py:340-347 returns (a, b, n) in the case dtype.

stages.triton: allocation (impl_triton.py:43) then one kernel launch, grid ceil(N/block) (46-56).
stages.cutile: allocation (impl_cutile.py:35) then one launch, grid ceil(N/tile) (55-57).
stages.note: Identical two-stage structure: timed output allocation + single-pass copy.

dependencies.triton: kernel depends only on the allocated output (impl_triton.py:43-47).
dependencies.cutile: kernel depends only on the allocated output (impl_cutile.py:35-57).

precision.triton: no arithmetic, no cast; store in the pointer dtype (impl_triton.py:21-25).

preprocessing.triton: only torch.empty(2N) inside run (impl_triton.py:43); block_size kwarg ignored.
preprocessing.cutile: only torch.empty(2N) inside run (impl_cutile.py:35); block_size kwarg ignored.
preprocessing.note: No casts, copies, layout changes or caches on either side.

intermediate_storage.triton: none; interleaved tile is register resident (impl_triton.py:21).
intermediate_storage.cutile: none; stacked (TILE,2) tile is register resident (impl_cutile.py:26).

mutation.triton: A, B never written; fresh output per call (impl_triton.py:43).
mutation.cutile: A, B never written; fresh output per call (impl_cutile.py:35).
mutation.note: Idempotent on both sides; contract forbids mutation.

hardware_dispatch.note: Tail handling differs only in mechanism (masked load/store impl_triton.py:15-25 vs zero-padded load + clipped store impl_cutile.py:24-27).

fq_boundary.note: n is the case parameter (tensors.py:631-632). Formula = read A (n) + read B (n) + write OUT (2n) at dtype_size bytes, which is exactly the single kernel's compulsory traffic on both sides. The only host work (output allocation) is inside run() and timed; nothing is cached or prepacked. flops_expr is nominal (no arithmetic).
